status: T8: committed before any change to the generator for set v2.3 (order 40430: after SIG-57's pre-registration, 73c7301). Not to be edited after the first run on set v2.3; a change is a new pre-registration, recorded as a deviation
author_disclosure: written by Claude Code, which also wrote the v2, v2.1 and v2.2 generators and will write v2.3. An independent review is required before any experiment uses set v2.3 (ticket section 6)
purpose: The adversarial leakage test for set v2.3: SIG-60's T7, unchanged, plus a structure family run against every label, including labels whose intended evidence is the biller or payee. Sets v2, v2.1 and v2.2 are negative controls; v2.2 must be caught on D-L4-1

t7_carried.unchanged: units, classifiers (split, stump, tree, logistic, per_family), margins, margin_rules, row_cap and its rule, every feature family, every label and its intended evidence, validity checks V1 to V6, the v2 and v2.1 channels, channels_rule and the false-alarm control. Nothing in SIG-60.json is edited

structure_family.rule: these families are never intended evidence for any label. A leak through one of them fails that label even when the label's intended evidence includes payee_identity or biller_structure

definitions.code: the line's billerCode as digits; a line without one has every code feature missing (the logistic's missing indicator, the stump's own category)
definitions.length, lead1, lead2, last1: digit count; first digit; first two digits; last digit
definitions.digit_sum_mod9: the sum of the code's digits, mod 9
definitions.rank_in_set: the code's rank among the distinct codes of the whole set, as a fraction (0 lowest, 1 highest)
definitions.rank_in_length: the same rank among the distinct codes of the same length
definitions.gap_to_nearest: the absolute difference to the nearest other distinct code of the same length, log10(1 + gap)
definitions.step_share: the share of the set's same-length codes whose difference to their next-lower code equals this code's difference to its next-lower code (a constant step, like v2.2's 91, gives a high share)
definitions.names_elsewhere: the number of distinct biller names that lines with this code carry on other applicants' lines
definitions.card_name_elsewhere: 1 when a line with this code on another applicant carries a biller name containing CARD
definitions.applicants: log2(1 + the number of other applicants with a line carrying this code)
definitions.id features: the numeric or hexadecimal part of the ID: digit sum mod 9 or first hex character; mod 7 and mod 91; the gap to the previous line's ID in the same account, by posting order

structure_family.label_blind: every feature is computed from the feed alone, never from a label or from truth, and the cross-applicant features read every applicant in both halves of the split, as a real detector could

labels_added.pool: pay credits of salaried single-employer applicants, in the account that receives most of their pay
labels_added.label: the credit is under either descriptor of a drift pair (ticket: 'lines under either descriptor', not a chosen side; review 11 L5)
labels_added.applies_to: v2.3 only. The v2.2 truth labels one side only, so the controls keep SIG-60's T-drift-line-main

labels_added.pool: pay credits of salaried single-employer applicants, in any other account
labels_added.label: the credit is under either descriptor of a drift pair

labels_re_registered.T-drift-line-main: on v2.3, replaced by T-drift-pair-main (review 11 L5: the side labelled was a coin flip, so its leakage score was uninformative). Kept unchanged for the controls
labels_re_registered.T-drift-line-second: on v2.3, replaced by T-drift-pair-second, for the same reason

validity_checks_added.V7-drift-lines: every drift-tagged applicant has at least one drift line; the drift label pool excludes applicants whose salary is paid to an unshared account or whose history is too short for a split (review 11 T3)
validity_checks_added.V8-reserved-names: every reserved unseen-lender name is invented: none is on the ASIC Professional Registers (credit licensees and credit representatives), checked by name, and the check record (name, register, search date, result) is committed (T9). No reserved name appears in src/ or in a test outside the generator (V6, carried)
validity_checks_added.V9-alias-repeats: no (lender, alias) pair is used by more than 4 declarations; at least 200 distinct pairs across the set's natural-form declarations (review 11 D-L4-3)
validity_checks_added.V11-code-distribution: biller and lender codes come from one distribution: the code-length distributions of bill billers, lender billers and unseen-lender billers do not differ (chi-squared, p > 0.05), and no code is shared by two biller names
validity_checks_added.V10-descriptor-words: the descriptor words added to declared names are drawn independently of the same/different flag: chi-squared on a descriptor-present by flag table, p > 0.05 (review 11 D-L4-2)

biller_codes.rule: every biller, bill or lender, seen or unseen, draws its length from this one distribution and its digits by HMAC-SHA256 of the seed and the biller's ID, with no leading zero; a collision redraws. No type digit, step, order by group or check digit. Each code has one registered biller name; a bank renders it in full or cut to its first 20 characters, chosen by HMAC of the line, independent of every label
biller_codes.basis: assumption: published BPAY biller codes are mostly 4 to 6 digits, with some shorter and longer. The distribution is a stated choice, not measured

declared_amounts.rule: declared monthly repayment = truth monthly x (1 + e), then rounded: 35% to the dollar, 35% to $10, 20% to $50, 10% to $100. e is 0 for 50% of declarations, else drawn from a normal with mean 0 and sd 0.08, clipped to [-0.25, 0.25]. All draws by HMAC of the seed and the declaration's ID
declared_amounts.basis: assumption: applicants round, and some misremember. No measured distribution is available; real-data comparison under SIG-61

generation_parameters.aliases: drawn from a generator larger than v2.2's 83 pairs, with V9's cap. Descriptor words drawn independently of the same/different flag (V10)
generation_parameters.realism: ticket section 5's flags, fixed where cheap: weekend card purchases, posting dates that differ from value dates, balances that reconcile with flows, wage advances not every cycle, a repayment channel mix that depends on type, declining loan balances, varied creationDate, no doubled product names. Each one not fixed is recorded with a reason before the first run

channels_added.finding: lender codes have 4 digits and bill codes 5 or 6: a 4-digit code is a repayment
the leading digit gives the liability type, and codes step by 91 within a type
reserved unseen lenders take the top codes
no-cue card codes carry CREDIT CARD names on other applicants' lines

pass_rule.set_v2.3: every label present (at least one positive) and within margin on every family, the structure family included, apart from limits re-registered here with their reasons; and every validity check (V1 to V11) passes
pass_rule.negative_controls: sets v2 and v2.1 are caught on every channel SIG-60 lists for them, and set v2.2 on each of D-L4-1a to D-L4-1d. A control not caught on a listed channel fails T7, and no v2.3 result stands

false_alarm_control: SIG-60's, carried, plus: over noise features with codes drawn from the v2.3 rule, labels drawn at random (SHA-256) at base rates of 2.5%, 10% and 40% are within margin on the structure family; and a planted code-length leak, a planted constant step, and a planted top-rank leak are each caught

tests.T1: the same seed twice gives byte-identical output; a different seed differs
tests.T3: truths valid and consistent, every labelled ID exists, and V7
tests.T4: the tax recompute matches, and the static scan is clean in both directions
tests.T5: population minimums met; request independence holds (chi-squared and permutation p > 0.05)
tests.T6: sets v1, v2, v2.1 and v2.2 regenerate to their published hashes
tests.T8: this file is committed before any change to the generator (checked from git history: no commit touching src/research/generator/ precedes it on the SIG-63 branch)
tests.T9: V8: the ASIC check record is committed and every reserved name returns no match

known_limits: the code-length and declared-amount distributions are stated assumptions, not measured
the structure family covers the channels review 11 found and their obvious relatives; a channel of a new kind could still pass it, which is why an independent review is required before use
the ASIC check is by name search on the day recorded; a lender licensed later under one of the names would not be caught

pre_run_amendments.rule: recorded before set v2.3 was generated and before any run on it (T7 or experiment). Each fills a gap in this file or records a build-time choice, with its reason. Nothing above is edited
pre_run_amendments.A1-rounding-floor: declared amounts: a rounding that would give $0 (a small repayment rounded to $50 or $100) falls back to the next finer unit; the result is never below $1. Reason: the rule as registered could declare $0, which no applicant does
pre_run_amendments.A2-card-cue-quota: a card issuer's registered BPAY name carries a card word (a cue) or is its legal name. 35% of issuers (rounded: 3 of 9) have no cue, the lowest by HMAC rank, as populations are set by quota. Reason: independent draws per issuer gave 1 of 9, and the no-card-biller-cue tag missed its minimum (18 < 20)
pre_run_amendments.A3-v9-pair: ruling, Colin, 20 November 2026 (SIG-63 comment after 40449): V9 counts a (lender, alias) pair the strict way. The alias is the declared name upper-cased, with punctuation removed and company-suffix and loan-type words dropped (PTY LTD LIMITED GROUP CORPORATION CORP CO INC CREDIT CARD CARDS PERSONAL CAR HOME LOAN LOANS MORTGAGE: SIG-60's rule's own list), so 'Comm Bank Pty Ltd credit card' is 'COMM BANK'. The lender is its ID
pre_run_amendments.A4-stated-choices: not measured: repayment channel shares (direct debit / BPAY; the rest a transfer): bill 0.50/0.40, credit card 0.15/0.55, personal and car loan 0.80/0.10, mortgage 0.70/0.05, BNPL 0.92/0, SACC 0.88/0.02, wage advance 0.95/0. Loan interest a year, on the closing balance, jittered ±10%: mortgage 6.2%, car 8.5%, personal 11.5%. Wage advances drawn in a pay cycle with chance 0.55 (at least two cycles). Card purchases post 0, 1 or 2 banking days after their value day (0.35, 0.45, 0.20)
pre_run_amendments.A5-alias-generator: made while building, to meet V9 under A3 (strict counts in order: 183, 187, 194, 203): the pool adds natural forms of each lender's legal name (its first word or two; abbreviations written out or contracted); a product word on 40% of names (30% before), a second one on 30% of those; and the generator itself draws a pair at most 3 times (strict count), inside V9's cap of 4. Every modifier is drawn independently of the same/different class (V10)
pre_run_amendments.not_fixed: ticket section 5 flags not fixed: overdrawn fees are not tied to a negative running balance (transaction accounts keep a positive cushion throughout, so an overdrawn fee can follow a debit that left the balance positive); cards carry no interest. Each recorded here before the first run, as realism requires
